name: Jira
description: Posts Jira issue and comment events into a forum, one thread per issue, and creates issues from the chat with /issue.

requested_grants.purpose: Create one forum post per Jira issue and answer /issue in it

data_egress: Issue and comment events of the configured Jira projects are posted into the forum. /issue sends the title and the description to the configured Jira site. With messages:read and events:subscribe, messages of people in linked threads go to Jira as comments, with their display name.
